column1: # Portuguese diacritic-fold table (D-436) - base letter -> every real accented/cedilla variant, so a token
# typed without its diacritic ("nao") still reaches the correctly-spelled word ("não"), both live while
# typing and at autocorrect/split-repair time. hints.tsv (same folder) picks one representative symbol per
# key for the AltGr long-press hint; this file keeps the complete set per base letter.
